name: Pieter van Dijk
bio:
Pieter van Dijk's career has been a meticulous climb through the ranks of corporate finance, culminating in his current role as Finance Controller for VW Racing Brasil. He began his career at a small accounting firm in Rotterdam, quickly proving his aptitude for numbers and strategic financial planning. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Pieter saw an opportunity to combine his professional skills with his personal passion when the position at VW Racing Brasil opened up.

Pieter's approach is characterized by rigorous analysis, unwavering attention to detail, and a relentless pursuit of financial efficiency. He believes in data-driven decision-making and is known for his ability to identify cost-saving opportunities and optimize resource allocation. His demanding nature pushes his team to perform at their best, ensuring the financial stability and long-term success of the racing team.

What sets Pieter apart is his deep understanding of both the financial world and the intricacies of motorsport. He knows that every euro counts, and he's committed to ensuring that VW Racing Brasil gets the most out of its financial investments, on and off the track.

physical.description: Pieter is a man of average height with a slightly stern but trustworthy face.

quirks: Always carries a meticulously organized spreadsheet printout in his briefcase.
Insists on using a vintage calculator for quick calculations, despite having access to modern software.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, often driving his colleagues slightly mad.
